summary.content:
Today's selection covers 61 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 37 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT Library to store your personal files
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ransomware's New Era: Moving at AI Speed
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, The Verge, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 36 articles published in the last 24 hours
